title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman backs Nobel Peace Prize for Donald Trump and Xi Jinping

title: Heavy LHB bogie corrosion worries Railways; toilet leaks, saline air blamed

title: China building new next-generation submarine as India's numbers stay constant
content: Fresh satellite imagery of China’s Bohai Shipyard shows a submarine believed to be a possible Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine under construction. The vessel features an apparent pumpjet propulsion system and X-shaped stern, suggesting efforts to improve stealth, efficiency and manoeuvrability. The development has regional implications as Pakistan expands its submarine fleet with eight Chinese-designed Hangor-class AIP submarines, expected to raise its fleet to 11. India operates 16 conventional and three strategic submarines, but fleet expansion has been delayed. Programmes including P-75I, Project-76 and indigenous nuclear attack submarines are progressing, but deliveries remain years away.

title: Wyoming storage shed turns out to be 140-year-old Chinese laundry
content: A weathered Wyoming cabin used as a storage shed for decades turned out to be a 140-year-old Chinese laundry and bathhouse owned by Sam Sing. After an eight-year effort, the historic building has been moved to a museum, where it will be restored and used to tell the story of Lander’s early Chinese community.

title: Detroit lawyer bought Motown mansion for $250,000, sold it for $1.65m
content: A century-old Detroit mansion with deep ties to the city’s music and industrial history once changed hands for just $250,000 before a painstaking restoration helped it sell for $1.65 million. Known as the Motown Mansion, the 10,500-square-foot residence at 918 W. Boston Blvd. was built in 1916-17 for lumberman Nels Michelson and later became the home of Motown Records founder Berry Gordy Jr. Historic Detroit identifies the property as the Nels Michelson Mansion and documents its origins, architecture and notable owners. Gordy bought the house in 1967 and lived there during a pivotal period for Motown before eventually selling it to Detroit attorney Cynthia F. Reaves, who restored the landmark and later sold it in 2017.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction before her Grand Slam success

title: The Revisit: When WWI reached India as German ship bombed Madras
content: On September 22, 1914, World War I reached India when the German cruiser SMS Emden shelled Madras, firing more than 125 shells in around 10 minutes. The attack set a Burmah Oil tank ablaze, damaged buildings and sent residents fleeing. This story revisits the dramatic raid, the Emden’s deceptive disguise, its mysterious retreat and how the German warship’s name became part of southern India’s vocabulary.

title: Russia planning 'grey zone operations'? Why is Europe intuitively spooked

Individually, each incident can be denied or dismissed as an accident but likely form a pattern that lets Moscow probe Nato's resolve without technically starting a war.
